name: zornade
title: Zornade MCP - Italian cadastral data for AI agents
description: Model Context Protocol server for Italian cadastral data: 85 million parcels with OMI valuations, hydrogeological and seismic risk, subsidence, solar potential and planning constraints. Six read-only tools.

tools.name: zornade_geocode_search
tools.title: Geocode Italian addresses
tools.description: Forward geocoding on ANNCSU street data: address to coordinates and cadastral reference.

tools.name: zornade_geocode_reverse
tools.title: Reverse geocode coordinates to addresses
tools.description: Coordinates to the nearest addresses and administrative units.

tools.name: zornade_parcel_by_id
tools.title: Get cadastral parcel profile
tools.description: Enriched profile of a parcel: cadastral data, OMI valuation, hydrogeological and seismic risk, subsidence, solar potential.

tools.name: zornade_parcel_locate
tools.title: Find parcels by coordinates or bounding box
tools.description: Parcels intersecting a point, a list of points or a bounding box.

tools.name: zornade_parcel_search
tools.title: Search parcels by cadastral reference
tools.description: Parcels by municipality, cadastral sheet and parcel label.

tools.name: zornade_admin_lists
tools.title: List Italian regions, provinces and municipalities
tools.description: Administrative reference lists for building the other queries.

freeTier.condition: Keep the attribution 'Dati elaborati da Zornade' visible in the product.

commercialLicence.removes: The Zornade attribution only. Source attributions (Agenzia delle Entrate, ISTAT, ISPRA, INGV, Copernicus) remain mandatory.
